authorization: 2026-11-15 actual user request to translate and reorganize repository documentation using the MailBox documentation architecture; this is not a new product-scope or acceptance approval.

requirements.title: Product identity and exclusions
requirements.statement: Provide the client desktop, files, viewers, explicit execution and PTY.
requirements.acceptance: Deliver authentication/desktop/file-open/exec/PTY/transfers without remote GUI, server helper, DB, AI or search.

requirements.title: Target OS and portable distribution
requirements.statement: Distribute for the specified client/server matrix and executable forms.
requirements.acceptance: Test Windows 11 x64/macOS 14 arm64-x64 against Ubuntu 24.04 amd64-arm64; exe/app needs no installed runtime and requires publisher-signing evidence.

requirements.title: No additional service or database
requirements.statement: Require neither an application DB nor sshOS-specific server installation.
requirements.acceptance: Use JSON/OS encryption; no remote agent/DB/Python/HTTP installation or local management listener.

requirements.title: Desktop workspace
requirements.statement: Provide consistent desktop, apps, taskbar and transfer shelf.
requirements.acceptance: One BrowserWindow with desktop/launchers/taskbar/persistent shelf and combined explorer tree/list; no fixed5-area or separate-tree substitute.

requirements.title: Profiles and validation
requirements.statement: Fix profile identity, validation and edit boundaries.
requirements.acceptance: At most 10 profiles, UUIDs/normalization/ranges, new ID on endpoint/username change and busy/unresolved edit restrictions.

requirements.title: Host-key trust
requirements.statement: Verify every authenticated SSH connection.
requirements.acceptance: Verify full blobs/fingerprints for all 3 roles; no credentials before approval; reject changes and renew backup-recovered trust.

requirements.title: Authentication and signatures
requirements.statement: Use selected supported password/key and reject weak signatures.
requirements.acceptance: One selected method once, supported keys, bounded reads/parser thread/deadline, RSA SHA256-512 only and no SHA1 signatures.

requirements.title: Sessions and generations
requirements.statement: Separate socket/channel lifetimes and identity across files/viewers/exec/PTY/probe.
requirements.acceptance: 3 servers,3 role sockets each/9 global; viewer4/2 per server, exec+PTY6/4; opening reservations, late cleanup, generations and isolated failures.

requirements.title: Feature-specific capabilities
requirements.statement: Judge OS/SFTP/probe/exec/PTY/path permission independently.
requirements.acceptance: Apply section 6 supported/unknown/unsupported policy and actual-request observations; preserve SFTP-only and denied features independently.

requirements.title: Paths and types
requirements.statement: Separate real/display paths and validate types/targets.
requirements.acceptance: POSIX/native paths, lengths/characters/tokens/types and actual exclusive collision checks; reject links/special/UNC within documented scope.

requirements.title: Browsing and refresh
requirements.statement: Keep per-window state and explicit limited refresh.
requirements.acceptance: Tree/list,10,000 entries/10 MiB, sort/hidden/stale-reply rules/manual refresh/one-parent refresh after own GUI mutation, no external watcher.

requirements.title: Single-folder creation
requirements.statement: Create one explicitly confirmed folder.
requirements.acceptance: Durable intent→mkdir 0700→ACK→lstat→receipt, no existing-name overwrite or implicit parents.

requirements.title: Rename and nonrecursive delete
requirements.statement: Follow regular-file rename and safe delete contracts.
requirements.acceptance: Hardlink then separate source unlink with partial/unknown outcomes; preserve destination, links, root and nonempty folders.

requirements.title: Transfer queue and concurrency
requirements.statement: Keep task queue/slots/path ownership separate from other features.
requirements.acceptance: 2 global/1-server slots,100 waiting, runnable FIFO, immutable identities, mixed preview and source/destination locks.

requirements.title: Upload
requirements.statement: Write temp, verify and finalize exclusively.
requirements.acceptance: Durable wx 0600 creation, bounded writes, full SHA256 read-back, hardlink finalization, separate cleanup, no overwrite.

requirements.title: Download
requirements.statement: Verify local temp and create final name exclusively.
requirements.acceptance: Bounded reads/short writes, sync-close-readback, fs.link, preserved collisions and no metadata cloning.

requirements.title: Integrity and progress
requirements.statement: Distinguish transfer, verification and execution observations.
requirements.acceptance: Show actual bytes/verification/finalization separately from stdout-stderr-exit; 100% bytes/exit 0 never implies whole business success.

requirements.title: Cancel and deadlines
requirements.statement: Apply operation-specific start/stop/cleanup deadlines.
requirements.acceptance: 5-s file cancel, request/no-progress deadlines, finalization race and viewer cancellation; no file timeout for silent exec/PTY.

requirements.title: Partial and unknown recovery
requirements.statement: Never convert uncertainty into automatic success or retry.
requirements.acceptance: Preserve partial/result_unknown across lost link-cleanup ACK, crash, backup, storage failure and current-location observations.

requirements.title: SSH response metric
requirements.statement: Restrict only the probe to literal /bin/true.
requirements.acceptance: Sample only normal exit+close,5-s cadence/deadline,15-s freshness,4-KiB output, identity/late-callback rules and unavailable state.

requirements.title: Application lifetime
requirements.statement: Separate renderer/worker/app/suspend from remote work.
requirements.acceptance: Apply internal/main-window close, crash, suspend, transfer continuity, PTY restore barrier and execution uncertainty distinctly.

requirements.title: JSON durability
requirements.statement: Use one writer and separate in-memory layout lifetime.
requirements.acceptance: Atomic replace/schema/checksum/backups/kind-specific receipts; main-only layout memory, no automatic replay after app restart.

requirements.title: Secrets and ephemeral content
requirements.statement: Encrypt only explicitly saved authentication data.
requirements.acceptance: OS encryption with no plaintext fallback; no automatic file/argv/input/output disk persistence; owning-session memory and transfer boundaries.

requirements.title: Electron authority and IPC
requirements.statement: Preserve sandbox, capabilities, named actions and bounded streams.
requirements.acceptance: Sender/schema/token/epoch, budgets, CSP/fuses; limited inline CSS only, no inline/eval JS/external HTML/local shell.

requirements.title: Network and logs
requirements.statement: Avoid unneeded traffic, output storage and external-change surveillance.
requirements.acceptance: Automatic selected SSH+necessary DNS only, no search/AI/telemetry/update/listener, redacted1-MiB×3 logs.

requirements.title: Fixed error presentation
requirements.statement: Show only observed phases and fixed Korean error codes/messages.
requirements.acceptance: Cover core/view/session/exec/PTY/stop codes and actions, without speculative causes/search/automatic repair.

requirements.title: Performance and accessibility
requirements.statement: Meet real resource/interaction budgets.
requirements.acceptance: Measure sizes/start/CPU/RSS/UI/listing/stability/keyboard/IME/contrast using specified hardware/network/repetitions.

requirements.title: Verification evidence
requirements.statement: Retain actual target, fault, performance and security evidence.
requirements.acceptance: Six-combination smoke, restricted fixtures, real scripts, coverage and hash/environment/action/actual evidence; never mark unrun pass.

requirements.title: Licenses and supply chain
requirements.statement: Meet project/upstream distribution and security obligations.
requirements.acceptance: AGPL-3.0-only text, actual/transitive licenses, SBOM, source/lock and applicable high-critical resolution; no blanket unrelated-code disclosure claim.

requirements.title: User value
requirements.statement: Evaluate understanding, usability and repeat use separately.
requirements.acceptance: Report G0/G2/G3 by product criteria or disclose unperformed/insufficient observation; research never substitutes technical/demand proof.

requirements.title: Git and public release
requirements.statement: Operate within real authority and technical gates.
requirements.acceptance: Actual remote/guards/current-head approval/cleanup, signatures, all technical checks and blocking defects; research remains separate.

requirements.title: Implementation and versioning
requirements.statement: Follow exact dependencies, D01–D13, verification and handoff.
requirements.acceptance: Bind actual implementation instruction to v6 digest, record lock/impact/regressions and document-versus-product checks.

requirements.title: Internal windows
requirements.statement: Implement geometry, min/max/restore, focus/taskbar and layout lifetime.
requirements.acceptance: 12 total/6 file/4 viewer; bounds/restoreBounds/modes, clamp/focus/keyboard/IME/main-memory snapshot per desktop contract.

requirements.title: UTF-8 text viewer
requirements.statement: Read bounded supported text as read-only plain content.
requirements.acceptance: Strict UTF8/BOM/NUL,2 MiB,100000-scalar lines, deadlines/cancel/change detection/manual reread and stream limits.

requirements.title: Image viewer
requirements.statement: Bound static PNG/JPEG/WebP decoding and fit/zoom.
requirements.acceptance: 20 MiB/40 MP/16384 edge, predecode headers, animation refusal, validated EXIF dimensions, one Worker bitmap, deadline/release; PNG-WebP EXIF unsupported, missing JPEG orientation 1.

requirements.title: Explicit GUI execution
requirements.statement: Confirm selected file, args/cwd and show output/exit.
requirements.acceptance: One-use preview, POSIX quoting, direct-sh-bash, open stdin, separate streams, observed exit, TERM/unconfirmed, never execute on double-click.

requirements.title: SSH PTY terminal
requirements.statement: Provide remote PTY input/display/resize/session.
requirements.acceptance: ssh2+xterm, resize/IME/sequenced input/frozen paste target, OSC-title-URI limits, backpressure, restore-send barrier, REP/memory protection.

requirements.title: Execution/window/connection lifetime
requirements.statement: Distinguish hide, stop, disconnect, exit and uncertainty.
requirements.acceptance: Keep hidden GUI execution, confirm PTY close, retain opening/late ownership, exit-close-loss distinction, unknown stop/no replay, typed receipts/restart.
